definitions.data: y is the sampled first-response fractional Rb/Cs readout. u=Delta U_used/c^2 is the dimensionless owner annual template, v=Delta U_bare/c^2 the model template. All sampled vectors must use the same declared epochs, time scale and binning.
definitions.design: W=W^T>0 and Z has full column rank; [Z,u] has full column rank. Z contains exactly the declared nuisance regressors, not new fitted physics. These are fixed-design identities; random estimated weights or selection require a conditional or uniform error argument.
definitions.calibration: gamma_eff=ell^T*v; if v=gamma*u+Z*c, then gamma_eff=gamma. Otherwise gamma_eff depends on the actual design and template discrepancy.
definitions.response: If y=-K*qS*x*v+Z*a+r+epsilon at first response with x=d^2>=0, then b_hat=-K*qS*x*gamma_eff+ell^T*r+ell^T*epsilon. r includes stated response, finite-potential, time/orbit-template and residual calibration errors without double counting.
definitions.bias: An error B*u changes b_hat by B and leaves the full fitted residual unchanged. An error in range(Z) changes neither b_hat nor the fitted residual. This is a non-implication witness, not evidence that a real annual systematic is present.
definitions.variance: For deterministic ell and actual covariance Sigma, Var(b_hat)=ell^T*Sigma*ell. Residual Gaussianity or marginal standard deviations alone do not determine Sigma or calibrate nuisance bias.
definitions.pointwise_remainder: If |r_i|<=rho_i on an admitted domain, |ell^T*r|<=sum_i |ell_i|*rho_i; this needs actual rho_i, not zeros by default.
definitions.two_body_only: Under a separately justified Newtonian two-body calibration mu_used=G_star*(M_S+M_E)*(1+x*qS*qE), gamma=G_star*M_S/mu_used=M_S/[(M_S+M_E)*(1+x*qS*qE)] at matched coordinates. If the reported mu_used is already the source-only parameter with recoil removed, the mass-fraction factor is absent. Neither is an identification of a GR-fitted ephemeris or the clock owner's printed normalization.
definitions.time_scaling: A common compatible linear coordinate scaling t'=F*t, r'=F*r, mu'=F*mu leaves mu/r invariant. Mixing GM and distance conventions does not. Actual clock time/ephemeris conversion remains source-owned; no physical time redefinition is made.

coverage_contract.common_measure: Choose either uniform repeated-sampling coverage over an admitted physical/nuisance domain or an explicit coherent joint epistemic probability law; do not mix posterior quantiles with frequentist guarantees without calibration.
coverage_contract.marginals: P(theta_i notin C_i)<=alpha_i for every included observational/calibration/material/remainder component, under the chosen common interpretation.
coverage_contract.joint: P(all theta_i in C_i)>=1-sum(alpha_i) by union bound; no cross-probe independence needed. Within-probe laws and selection/calibration validity remain required.
coverage_contract.moment_alternative: If E[e_i]=0 and E[e_i^2]<=V_i are certified, Chebyshev gives P(|e_i|>=sqrt(V_i/alpha_i))<=alpha_i. Add a separately certified bias/remainder bound B_i. A quoted plug-in sigma is not automatically such a V_i.

test_only_inputs.label: SYNTHETIC EXACT ARITHMETIC FIXTURES, NOT OBSERVATIONS, PHYSICAL CARRIERS OR FITS

non_claims: No actual estimator reconstruction, acquired covariance or bias certificate, model exclusion, TECT/Pre-A/A/B/spacetime/QFT/GR/continuum/mass-gap/TOE result. Conditional standard algebra exposes required inputs; it does not supply them.
